run_grpc_interop_server: run the gRPC interoperability test server on a specified port with optional TLS support
serve_grpc_test_service: start a gRPC test server that registers the TestService servicer and waits for termination
parse_interop_server_arguments: parse command line arguments for the gRPC interop server including port and TLS flags
get_server_credentials: retrieve SSL server credentials using a private key and certificate chain for secure connections
test_grpc_server_startup: test the gRPC interop test server startup with insecure or secure port binding
